newsitem.title: DENMARK: SOCCER-BRONDBY PLANNING CAUTIOUS APPROACH AGAINST TENERIFE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BRONDBY PLANNING CAUTIOUS APPROACH AGAINST TENERIFE.

text.p: Brondby's bid to become the first Danish club to reach the final of a European club competition continues on Tuesday -- with coach Ebbe Skovdahl warning fans to be patient.

He is intending to adopt a defensive, safety-first approach against Tenerife in the second leg of their UEFA Cup quarter-final. Brondby go into the game 1-0 up on aggregate courtesy of Ebbe Sand's goal in the first leg. "I know very well that everyone expects us to play fun soccer and eliminate Tenerife with a welter of goals but the most important thing for us is to go ahead to the semifinals," Skovdahl said.
"I cannot say Brondby are favourites. Tenerife are a team with a very impressive away record."
Skovdahl has to reshuffle his side in the absence of suspended midfielder John Jensen, who picked up his second yellow card of the competition in the first leg.
Brondby became the only Danish club ever to reach the semifinals of a European competition when they reach the last four of this competition in 1991. They were eliminated by Roma 2-1 on aggregate.

Tenerife, attempting to become the first team from Spain to win the UEFA Cup since Real Madrid 11 years ago, will be without injured Czech international Pavel Hapal and influential midfielder Felipe Minambres, who also picked up his second yellow card in the first leg. Striker Antonio Robaina was sent off in that game and will also be absent in Denmark.
However the Spaniards are going into the match in a positive frame of mind with defender Cesar Gomez, for one, believing his team can advance.
"We're better than they are and we have to show it from the first minute," he said on Monday.

Brondby (from): Mogens Krogh, Claus Udengaard; Soeren Colding, Per Nielsen, Dan Eggen, Anders Bjerregaard, Jes Riisager, Lars Olsen, Ole Bjur, Kim Vilfort, Allan Ravn, Kim Daugaard, Thomas Thoegersen, Ebbe Sand, Ruben Bagger, Bo Hansen, Peter Moeller
Tenerife (probable): Marcelo Ojeda; Alexis Suarez, Cesar Gomez, Pablo Paz, Antonio Mata, Chano Cruzado, Dani Gonzalez, Angel Vivar Dorado, Slavisa Jokanovic, Juanele Castanos, Meho Kodro.
